purpose: Unattended full Escort (護送) PvE match, the map-selection counterpart to U-pve-fullmatch.json: lobby -> dismiss any AFK popup -> create a PvE room -> dismiss any host-transfer popup -> select_map('defense', i.e. 防衛作戰/Map_PC02, the only click-tested map entry -- see actions.py's MAP_ENTRIES) -> F5 start -> win every round with GameCampaign 1 -> wait for the result screen and the automatic return to the room -> dismiss any popup -> leave the room -> back in the lobby. Exercises the map-independent battle-HUD detector (screens.battle_hud_state(), see actions.py's campaign_win_all docstring) on a map other than the one its predecessor reference shots came from -- this is the one 2026-09-20 escort-smoke run already confirmed live end to end minus the select_map click itself (docs/journal/2026-09-20-0110-escort-smoke.md: 5 rounds via GameCampaign 1, EndGame, room). 🟡 select_map step not run live yet as part of this experiment file.
